description: This is a PHP test class for the DataGroupDao's getApiPermissions method within the Authorization DAO, verifying API permissions behavior for different user groups in the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: DataGroupDaoGetApiPermissionsTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing the getApiPermissions method of DataGroupDao with different user group scenarios.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test fixture, loads test data from YAML file, and instantiates DataGroupDao.

methods.name: testGetApiPermissionsForEss
methods.description: Tests API permissions retrieval for the 'ESS' group, expecting a single permission with read access only.

methods.name: testGetApiPermissionsForEssAndAdmin
methods.description: Tests API permissions retrieval for 'ESS' and 'Admin' groups, expecting two permission objects with different access levels.
